# Loading in Kimi

Kimi has no skill mechanism, so it takes the self-contained single-file core:

1. Open [`prompts/lumi-style-core.md`](../prompts/lumi-style-core.md) and copy it in full;
2. paste the core prompt as the system prompt (API: the system field; web: the first message);
3. Then issue tasks normally ("Following the rules above, write…").

The core is self-contained with zero tool assumptions; on any conflict, `references/` wins. Re-copy it after a rule update — it is a snapshot, and this one is 0.1.388.
